name: Electric Sheep
description: Do androids dream of electric sheep? And do those sheep drive electric tanks? And would those tanks be equipped with this paint? Nobody knows. That knowledge has been lost in time, like tears in the rain.
interestingFacts: The paint could be received as a reward for completing the challenges of the challenge (09/01/2019 - 09/29/2019) with a battle pass.
Contrary to what it's name suggests, wearers of this paint are known for standing out in a crowd and making their own way in battle.
